cause: The temporary harness used spawnSync while the same Node process hosted the loopback registry fixture; the synchronous child launch blocked the fixture event loop and timed out after 120 seconds. The assertion saw spawnSync status null. This does not establish a CLI sync failure.
corrective_action: Changed only the throwaway harness to use asynchronous child_process.spawn so the loopback fixture can service requests. No production source or accepted source/eval bytes changed.
